name: io.github.sepehr071/amar-mcp
title: Statistical Centre of Iran
description: Read-only Statistical Centre of Iran (amar.org.ir): CPI inflation, unemployment, census, any table.

environmentVariables.name: AMAR_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the amar.org.ir requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
